Method of Attack: exfiltrating contact lists, SMS, IMEI, location info, IP address, and all photos stored in the device
Impacted Systems: Android devices used by Israeli users
Attack Vector: APK files disguised as social applications (Threema, Al-Aqsa Radio, Al-Aqsa Mosque, Jerusalem Guide, PDF viewer, Wire, etc.)
Facebook posts or WhatsApp messages pointing to websites hosting malicious APKs
Google Drive links to lure victims with classified PDF documents
Indicators of Compromise: APK files pretending to be mobile versions of legitimate apps like Adobe Reader, Threema, Telegram, PDF viewer, Al-Aqsa Radio, Al-Aqsa Mosque, Jerusalem Guide
Use of commercial spyware tools SpyNote, Mobihok, WH-RAT, 888RAT, Metasploit, EsecretRAT with custom code
Links distributed via Facebook, WhatsApp, and Google Drive
